resources.string: T0 hostile-app spike. Reads the active window\'s accessibility tree and performs one tap / one text entry on demand, to test whether an AccessibilityService can perceive and act on third-party apps. Drive it with adb broadcasts.
Service: ENABLED — ready. Drive it with the adb scripts in /scripts.
Service: DISABLED — tap below, then enable \"Spike A11y Harness\".

After enabling the service, drive it from your host:

# dump the current screen’s a11y tree
adb shell am broadcast -n org.agentnativeos.spike/.CommandReceiver -a org.agentnativeos.spike.DUMP

# tap a node by its text
adb shell am broadcast -n org.agentnativeos.spike/.CommandReceiver -a org.agentnativeos.spike.TAP --es text "Search settings"

# type into an editable field
adb shell am broadcast -n org.agentnativeos.spike/.CommandReceiver -a org.agentnativeos.spike.TYPE --es text "hello"

Dumps land in: /sdcard/Android/data/org.agentnativeos.spike/files/dumps/
Logcat tags: SPIKE, SPIKE_TREE, SPIKE_ACT, SPIKE_CMD
